title: POST-H-027-D — Windows install guide and smoke
pass_criteria: Guide documents editable, wheel and ZIP Windows flows.
Artifact paths remain inside the workspace and required wheel/ZIP artifacts exist for those modes.
API localhost/token posture is documented without wildcard host/CORS.
Frontend npm prerequisite is advisory for Python core when Node/npm is absent.
No admin, network, external API, publish, deploy, sockets or source mutation is required.
block_criteria: Guide points to non-existent CLI commands.
Artifact path escapes the workspace or required artifact is absent.
Guide recommends host 0.0.0.0, wildcard CORS or unrestricted execution policy.
Smoke hides frontend prerequisite failures instead of classifying them.
Smoke mutates source files or requires admin privileges.
risks: This sprint does not create a Windows MSI or persistent service.
The smoke validates the operator recipe without executing pip/npm; real end-user install remains a manual or future automated path.
Upgrade/rollback dry-run remains pending for POST-H-027-E.
